questionEn: Which conclusion on the topic “The importance of minerals in human life” can be considered correct?
questionUz: “Foydali qazilmalarning inson hayotidagi ahamiyati” mavzusidagi qaysi xulosani to‘g‘ri deb hisoblash mumkin?
choicesEn: Organic substances consisting of carbon, hydrogen and oxygen (sugar, etc.)
choicesUz: Uglerod, vodorod va kisloroddan (shakar va boshqalar) tashkil topgan organik moddalar.
